comparison.objective: Progressively seat a flexible power cord along a curved channel.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential deformable routing and distributed pressing along a bend.
comparison.success_condition: All eight channel sections must contain the cord below the lip for one second without moving the fixtures or pulling the cord from its box.
comparison.reason: Tests global deformable-object routing and seating, not rigid coaxial tooling, discrete impact fracture, or loose-fragment containment.
